title: 34MM NH05 Watch Case bezel insert ring sapphire glass stainless steel screw in crown women's watch case, suitable for NH05 NH06 movement
description:
34mm  NH05 Watch Case Stainless Steel Women’s Watch Case for NH05/NH06 – Sapphire Crystal, Screw-In Crown, Fits 24.2–25mm Dials

Key Features:

  • Compatible with NH05 & NH06 Movements – Precisely engineered case structure for stable installation of NH05/NH06 automatic movements.

  • Premium Sapphire Crystal – Durable sapphire glass available with or without a magnifier ring, offering excellent clarity and scratch resistance.

  • Stainless Steel Construction – Robust steel case provides longevity with a refined appearance suitable for women’s watch builds.

  • Screw-In Crown & Case Back – Features a screw-in spiral crown and a screw-in glass back cover for secure assembly and improved moisture resistance.

  • 3ATM Water Resistance – Suitable for daily wear and splash protection.

  • Bezel Insert Ring Included – 34mm NH05 bezel insert ring designed for a clean, precise fit.

Size / Dimensions:

  • Case Diameter: 34mm (excluding crown)

  • Case Thickness: 12mm (without protrusions)

  • Dial Fit: 24.2mm–25mm

  • Strap Width: 13.2mm–17mm

  • Strap Length: 18cm

Package Contents (optional, if included):

  • 1 × Watch Case (Stainless Steel)

  • 1 × Sapphire Crystal (with/without magnifier ring)

  • 1 × Screw-In Crown

  • 1 × Glass Back Cover
